the yield window runs with the interrupts masked: no sample, no charge and no self-switch
the deadline window raises the pending flag without a switch inside an interrupt and survives a real interrupt
the global window splits the local samples into busy and idle, and only the BSP advances the global time base
the remote window proves a real resched SGI4 delivery on the target while the target's periodic tick keeps running
